newsitem.title: GERMANY: German farmers prepare for spring sowings.
newsitem.headline: German farmers prepare for spring sowings.

text.p: German farmers are planning a swift spring planting campaign in March to take advantage of warm and dry conditions, the DWD national meterorological office said.
"Conditions are ideal, soils are dry and the warmth will aid germination," a source in the farm weather section said on Friday.
Farmers will start with spring barley, followed by some spring rapeseed and wheat, while sugar beet plantings typically begin at the end of the month.
Maize and sunseed plantings start in April.
The DWD source added winter grains and oilseeds were developing slowly but steadily, and winter damage appeared limited.
Maximum daytime temperatures over the next seven days will be in a 13-20 degree range.
